question: In a certain code language, MUTINY is written as 25149202113 and MAGIC is written as 397113. How will NECTAR be written in the same language?
solution:
The position of letters according to alphabetic series is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95f2da2565fc359d4dd490ab1d9e89115e8fef221fecc9d6b90f87f0f675ab7e.png] 

The logic followed here is,

 
• MUTINY is coded as 25149202113,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7d6ea690c5581eae8823612fa7218ebeece1fff7326fabaa21fe6a529790e7db.png] 

 
• MAGIC is coded as 397113,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3372e2787489f469a440e12e327e3184da0a35017f148e913f547f4aa6086da5.png] 

 
• NECTAR is coded as,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4071d9ae32ca54c24bbb4211aff1982803d448133d06e714804cc94d9cc750f6.png] 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1 i.e. 181203514".**
